lines: Even when you’re beside me, we remain apart.
A binary star that cannot become one.
Albireo
Ah, more than you think,
I am filled with you.
I want to watch the fleeting, meteor‑like moments
without letting them slip even for an instant.
Ah, more than I think,
you have always been far away.
Your gestures appear to overlap.
They are beautiful to the point of pain.
The feeling that I love you
decorates the night sky without leaving a trace.
My heart offers the leftover excuses,
I don’t want to call that love.
You are Albireo floating in indigo.
This heart stays stolen.
If you don’t want it, give it back.
I have nowhere else to put it, though.
Even now, a fragment of “I‑miss‑you”
burns in the stratosphere.
Even when you’re beside me, we remain apart.
A binary star that cannot become one.
Albireo
Shining light‑years ahead.
I fell in love with you.
So far ahead that the distance can’t be measured.
Alas, your light was too dazzling.
With the feeling that I love you,
the stars revolve solely because of it.
An excuse to live for tomorrow.
I want to try calling it love.
You are Albireo floating in indigo.
This heart stays stolen.
If you don’t want it, give it back.
I have nowhere else to put it, though.
Even now, a fragment of “I‑miss‑you”
burns in the stratosphere.
Even when you’re beside me, we remain apart.
A binary star that cannot become one.
You are Albireo colored by love.
This heart burns as if yearning.
I loved you more closely than anyone.
It never reaches, yet.
Even now, a pulse beyond temperature
shouts that I love you.
Even apart, we do not fade.
Two stars that never become one.
Albireo
